title: macOS kernel overflow found
text: Finds an integer overflow in the macOS kernel through collaboration with outside security researchers, leading to a patched CVE in a shipped operating system release.

title: Pion DTLS bug sweep
text: Scans a WebRTC security library with a hosted code scanner and returns 36 bugs, including six security vulnerabilities, some sitting undetected for over four years.

title: Hairdryer diagnostic report
text: Reads vibration and sensor data from a hairdryer through tool calls and writes an operator-style diagnostic report on the machine's condition in plain language.

title: Faulty GPU memory diagnosed
text: Diagnoses a graphics card with faulty video memory from its error behavior, then writes a software workaround so the card stays usable.

title: R&D tax credit miscategorization
text: Analyzes past R&D reports and expenses, finds the auditor miscategorized the company, and drafts a reply citing the right tax code that restores an eight-thousand-dollar credit.

title: Cloud bill savings found
text: Reviews a cloud account's line items and identifies resources costing about 250 dollars a month that can be removed.

title: Slow gaming news page profiled
text: Profiles a gaming news page in headless Chrome to see why it loads slowly and writes up a report of the offending scripts.

title: Laptop wifi fault fixed
text: Diagnoses intermittent wifi problems on a decade-old ThinkPad and applies an obscure kernel parameter that resolves the fault.

title: VM memory behavior traced
text: Works through diagnostic commands to track down strange memory behaviour inside a virtual machine, saving hours of manpage and forum reading.

title: Production bug found faster
text: Locates a production bug in four-year-old hand-written code by reading the failing behavior against the source, faster than its original author managed.

title: Bug found in log window
text: Finds a bug that cost a colleague three days by reading the logs from the failure window against the codebase, in ten minutes.

title: Delphi deadlock and leak diagnosis
text: Reads stack traces and a memory-leak report from a large multithreaded Delphi program and pinpoints a lock-ordering deadlock and a cross-thread event bus leak.

title: Production race condition found
text: Traces a production race condition that engineers had chased for two weeks and identifies the unsynchronized shared state in seconds.

title: Open-source security sweep results
text: Scans open-source projects for vulnerabilities and reports hundreds of security issues, including protections that silently failed to run.

title: Firefox vulnerability reports
text: Hunts through the Firefox codebase for flaws and submits over a hundred reports, of which twenty-two became security advisories fixed in a release.

title: Hospital bill errors flagged
text: Checks an itemised hospital bill's procedure codes for duplicate charges and improper coding, helping a family appeal and cut a 195,000 dollar balance to about 33,000.

title: Security audit workflow
text: Maps a web application's routes and authentication paths, then walks the code in stages for injection and access-control flaws, producing a prioritized findings list.

title: Medical bill repricing
text: Compares an uploaded medical bill against Medicare cost data to spot overpriced lines and drafts a negotiation letter for the patient.

title: Tool-regression audit of sessions
text: Audits thousands of coding sessions to show that a coding assistant's behavior degraded for weeks, producing a forensic report later confirmed by its vendor.

title: Forgotten subscriptions found
text: Reads pasted bank and card statements to list recurring charges, surfacing subscriptions the owner had forgotten and totaling the monthly waste.

title: Wallet theft bug spotted
text: Spots the trivial coding flaw behind a recent bitcoin wallet theft when given the vendor's code, a check the commenter says should have been run earlier.

title: Bugs in compositor libraries
text: Finds bugs in two Wayland graphics libraries while working on a project, reporting them though preferring to patch around them locally.

title: Denial-of-service bug library
text: Hunts through software for specific denial-of-service flaws and buffer overflows under a vendor verification program, building a private collection of unreported findings.

title: Mobile game crash investigation
text: Investigates memory leaks and crashes in a Unity mobile game across eighteen sessions as part of a developer's 47-day usage log.

title: Failing test root cause
text: Examines a failing test in a large messy Python codebase, finds the root cause, and asks whether it is a regression or an underspecified test.

title: Thread-safety bug caught
text: Catches a subtle thread-safety bug in test code that a cheaper worker missed, once handed the right context.

title: Harness bugs found
text: Finds several bugs in a hobbyist's custom test harness while being compared against rival chatbots on bug hunting.

title: Per-file vulnerability loop
text: Loops over every file in a source tree, asking for the most serious vulnerability in each and writing it to an output folder.

title: Discourse image bug exploit
text: Probes a forum platform's image handling for a bug and, after a newer release, finds a way to exploit it.

title: Instruments trace analysis
text: Exports Apple Instruments performance traces into a SQL database so scroll hitches and CPU hotspots in a Mac app can be diagnosed automatically.

title: CI failure debugger
text: Reads failing continuous-integration logs and diagnoses why builds break, proposing the fix inside the pull request.

title: Session transcript review
text: Scans coding-session transcripts for bugs and risky approvals, filing issues that cite the exact lines, after one found a flawed change the author had waved through.

title: Records review for diagnosis
text: Runs a staged diagnostic workflow over a person's medical records covering literature research and differential diagnosis, looping until confidence passes a threshold.

title: Self-healing doctor loop
text: Reads logs, diagnoses failures and repairs a crashed always-on assistant gateway, escalating to a chat alert when the fix fails.

title: Linux server hardening audit
text: Audits a Linux host's configuration for security weaknesses and reports findings through a reusable plugin.

title: Kubernetes cluster investigation
text: Investigates cluster issues and audits Kubernetes security and outdated components through reusable troubleshooting slash commands.

title: Alert triage procedure
text: Triages a firing production alert by sizing the problem, finding its signature in metrics and logs, and testing the leading hypothesis against a second source.

title: Incident investigation harness
text: Investigates production incidents for a data platform by reading telemetry and proposing fixes under restricted permissions.
